browser_tests.notes: Existing monitoring scenarios passed on the final frontend image; login/admin scenarios passed in a targeted final rerun after correcting test selectors.

deployment.bootstrap_login: passed; admin role and mandatory password change verified
deployment.forwarded_ip_spoof: rejected; forged 8.8.8.8 header did not change logged client IP
deployment.container_health: backend, frontend, worker, PostgreSQL and Redis healthy; Nginx running
deployment.live_login_render: desktop and mobile passed without page errors

geoip.lookup: local; no visitor IP sent to external services

limitations: HTTP deployment; HTTPS must be configured for encrypted LAN login and secure cookies.
Country is an approximate network location; LAN addresses have no inferred country.
NAT, Docker Desktop and VPN can hide the original visitor address behind a shared gateway.
Browser/user-agent and attempted login username are client-reported, not verified physical identities.
Earlier security findings outside authentication/access monitoring are not all remediated by this feature.
